headline: Poland's fleet grows stronger. Investments like this haven't been seen in years
summary: Poland's navy may acquire up to 35 new units by 2039, including frigates, corvettes, submarines and logistics vessels, in its biggest modernisation programme in decades, according to Rzeczpospolita.
why: Large defence procurement programmes create orders for shipbuilders and defence contractors and affect national budget allocations.
original_headline: Polska flota rośnie w siłę. Takich inwestycji nie było od lat
